items.title: 13.2.3 Nature of Excretory Products in relation to Habitat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nitrogenous wastes and habitat (PDF 6-7).

blocks.text: Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation jism se metabolic fuzlaat (metabolic wastes, jism ke kimiyai amal se bane bekaar madde) nikalne ke saath juri hui hai. Nitrogen wale fuzlaat (nitrogenous wastes, maslan ammonia, urea, uric acid) sab se aham metabolic fuzlaat hain. Yeh fuzlaat pani mein ghol kar nikale jate hain. Mukhtalif maskanon (habitats, rehne ki jagah) ke janwar nitrogen wale fuzlaat ki mukhtalif shaklen nikalte hain. Maslan:
